att.title: My attendance
att.description: Check in when you arrive and check out when you leave. The time recorded is the server's time.
att.loadError: Your attendance could not be loaded.
att.noEmployment: Your user is not linked to a current employment
att.noEmployment.body: Ask HR to link your user to your employment, then come back.
att.company.pick: Choose the company you are punching for.
att.next.out: You are checked in. Check out when you leave.
att.duplicate: This punch is within {seconds} seconds of an earlier one and will not be counted twice.
att.error.generic: The punch could not be recorded. Try again.
att.error.network: The server could not be reached. Try again.
att.scan.title: Scan to punch
att.scan.body: Scan the QR code shown at the gate with your phone camera, or type the code shown under it.
att.kiosk.title: Attendance kiosk
att.kiosk.description: Type your badge or PIN number and choose check in or check out.
att.qr.title: Gate QR code
att.qr.description: Show this screen at the gate. The code changes every {seconds} seconds; employees scan it while signed in.
att.qr.noLocations.body: Add a location in the organization settings first.
